notableFixes: Matched function names and starter signatures to reference solutions.
Added JSON-to-node adapters for trees and linked lists, plus operation-based class fixtures.
Judge modified inputs for in-place exercises, including the unique prefix returned by Remove Duplicates.
Accept valid alternative answers, unordered result sets, and floating-point tolerances.
Fixed disconnected negative-cycle detection, cyclic linked-list flattening, zero-difference self-pairing, and singular determinant handling.
Fixed 360-degree visibility double counting and negative-valued window minima.
Replaced greedy cash settlement with an exact minimum-payment search and a counterexample fixture.
Corrected graph-coloring fixtures that confused adjacency matrices with adjacency lists.
Corrected misleading algorithm labels, complexity claims, ambiguous outputs, and constraints.
Replaced deep recursive traversal and array shifting where they violated JavaScript limits or claimed complexity.
Unified examples with executable fixtures and kept code text readable in both themes.
Run samples automatically and terminate slow code after five seconds inside the opaque-origin sandbox.
Added a mandatory build validation gate.
verificationLimits: Tests cover curated examples, edge cases, selected large inputs, and exhaustive small-input oracles. They are not a proof of correctness for every possible input.
